anchors.label: Parking serving the Old and New Karuizawa areas
anchors.notes: 町営旧軽井沢駐車場 is the named mapped parking feature. The tourism association publishes municipal parking information; OSM supplies the mapped lot geometry. Route to this anchor, then walk to the attraction.

karuizawa-town.reason: Official visitor information identifies parking serving the area; final access is parking plus an attraction walk.

anchors.label: Parking serving Kyu-Karuizawa Ginza Street
anchors.notes: 町営旧軽井沢駐車場 is the named mapped parking feature serving the pedestrian shopping street. The tourism association identifies the street and publishes parking information; OSM supplies the mapped lot geometry. Route to the anchor, then walk to the attraction.

kyu-karuizawa-ginza.reason: Official destination and visitor information support car-to-parking access, followed by walking access to the street.
